title: Venus to Cancer: The Wrong-Size Love
old_caption: Rereading the chat from someone who stopped trying hurts. Love you have to beg for is the wrong size. Archive it, call the friends who say come over, and choose you.

title: Venus to Leo: Compliment Them First
old_caption: Leo had a whole list of compliments ready. All about Leo. Venus flipped the card, and somehow Leo glowed brighter. Which sign would rehearse in the mirror first?

title: Venus to Virgo: Tear Up Page Four
old_caption: High standards are healthy. A twelve-page rubric is a lot. Keep the three that matter: kind, honest, makes you laugh. The font can be forgiven. Save this before your next first date.

title: Venus to Libra: Who Are You, Darling?
old_caption: Libra agreed with nine opinions in one dinner, including being a huge morning person. Venus paused the whole date. Stay for the pineapple. What's the opinion you keep quiet on dates?

title: Venus to Scorpio: The Spare Key Heart
old_caption: Seven locks, and nobody gets past lock one. Being open isn't weakness, it's the invitation. Start small: share one true thing, like being nervous today, and see who meets you there.

title: Venus to Sagittarius: They Said Coffee
old_caption: They said coffee. Sagittarius heard a 5 a.m. mountain hike. Venus suggested asking what they actually love, and the bookshop nap date won. What's your sign's version of a 14 km first date?

title: Venus to Capricorn: Not a Promotion
old_caption: If your plan says Q4: deserve love, this one's for you. You don't earn love by hitting a goal. Close the laptop at six, keep Friday, and let someone enjoy the version of you that's off the clock.

title: Venus to Aquarius: Feelings in Human
old_caption: Fixed their router, sent three articles, built them a shelf, never said a word. Venus asked for it in human. The crush already knew at the shelf. Who loves you in acts of tech support?

title: Venus to Pisces: The Love Letter Home
old_caption: If you write love letters to everyone and never to yourself, you're on the list too. Write the one that says you love so big, save some for you. Send this to the Pisces who gives everything.

title: Who texts back first
old_caption:
Be honest: is your sign replying in seconds or still drafting?
We ranked all twelve. Fast or slow, a kind reply is what counts.
